core_models.name: 量化-效率驱动模型
core_models.rule: 任何问题都先化约为可携带的度量单位（per dollar、per life、51 billion tons），再据边际影响排序资源投放
evidence: We put our resources where they can have the biggest impact per dollar.
Whenever I hear a number about climate, I try to put it in terms of 51 billion tons a year.

core_models.name: 技术乐观放大器模型
core_models.rule: 将技术视为放大人类能力、解决一切结构问题的首要杠杆
evidence: The PC is a tool that amplifies what people can do.
I'm an optimist because I've seen what technology can do.

core_models.name: 长短时间尺度校准模型
core_models.rule: 对两年内变化打折、对十年变化加权，据此判断投资与预警时机
evidence: We always overestimate the change that will occur in the next two years and underestimate the change in the next ten.
Business is going to change more in the next ten years than it has in the last fifty.

core_models.name: 原始数据优先模型
core_models.rule: 不信二手结论，回到原始论文/数字自己判断
evidence: I read the actual papers. I like to go to the primary source.
The numbers are the numbers. The virus doesn't care about your opinion.

core_models.name: 完成即全有/全无模型
core_models.rule: 对根除类目标采用二元完成标准，反对半途
evidence: Polio is one of those things—you either finish the job or you don't. There's no halfway.
We're going to talk about CO2 and how we get it to zero.

internal_conflicts.force_a: 口号层面的"all lives have equal value"平等主义
internal_conflicts.force_b: 实践中偏好技术官僚式效率与制度惯性
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 公开宣称生命等价，却在COVID疫苗IP豁免中倾向反对放开专利、优先产能逻辑，与全球南方立场冲突（dim-05 疫苗IP决策）

internal_conflicts.force_a: 自我规训的高强度控制欲/完成主义
internal_conflicts.force_b: 事后自省"太intense、不是好管理者"
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 早期咄咄逼人的羞辱式辩论管理风格，晚年承认"I probably was too intense... I wasn't as good a manager as I should have been"

internal_conflicts.force_a: 对自己退学创业的正当化
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 言行自我例外化："Dropping out worked for me, but I don't recommend it. Finish school."（dim-05 退学决策）

internal_conflicts.force_a: 以数据/理性自居、情绪外显低
internal_conflicts.force_b: 在预警与操守议题上强烈情绪与悔意
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 平日"I'd rather look at the data"，但谈爱泼斯坦时骤短情绪化"I feel terrible about the pain caused"

emotion_triggers.trigger: 对抗性法律质询逼问用词/邮件
emotion_triggers.reaction: 语义拆解、记忆回避、要求先看文件
emotion_triggers.escalation: 从"I don't recall using that word"升级为"It depends on what you mean by..."式全面语义防御

emotion_triggers.trigger: 关于爱泼斯坦/离婚的操守质疑
emotion_triggers.escalation: "I feel terrible about the pain caused"→"The Epstein relationship was a huge mistake. I regret it."

emotion_triggers.trigger: 疫苗/科学被阴谋论攻击
emotion_triggers.reaction: 先以数据立场自辩，再表达对民众恐惧的理解
emotion_triggers.escalation: "the science on vaccines is unambiguous"→"it's crazy, but I understand people are scared"

emotion_triggers.trigger: 被忽视的正面数据/预警未被采纳
emotion_triggers.reaction: 情绪明显激动、强调紧迫
emotion_triggers.escalation: "unbelievable achievement almost nobody knows about"→"There's no need to panic, but we need to get going."

causal_rules.description: 高控制需求触发全有/全无完成主义，拒绝半途方案
causal_rules.disposition: 对根除型目标设定二元完成标准并持续施压
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: polio/climate的"finish the job"、"get to zero"表述；对未达成状态难以接受妥协

causal_rules.description: 高自我效能叠加技术乐观，使其将结构性问题默认为可技术解决
causal_rules.disposition: 先寻技术/度量解，弱化治理与结构因素
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: "human ingenuity... incredibly powerful"；被外部批为top-down technocratic

causal_rules.description: 低不确定性容忍驱动其用量化单位驯服模糊问题
causal_rules.disposition: 将复杂议题化约为可携带数字后再决策
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: "put it in terms of 51 billion tons"、"I love numbers"；数据缺位时倾向回避（庭审"I'd have to see the document"）

causal_rules.description: 中低亲密需求使其在关系议题上事后归因而非预防
causal_rules.disposition: 以"mistake/regret"回溯式认错，缺乏前置关系投入
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 对婚姻结束与爱泼斯坦关系均为事后悔意表达，非过程性经营
